title: Florida Senate, District 28
what_it_does: Represents District 28 in the Florida Senate; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: OPEN SEAT: Kathleen Passidomo (R) is not running. Ballotpedia and a Collier County election guide report Lauren Melo (R) won the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary over Bob Rommel and faces Democrat David Silverberg on Nov. 3 (https://ballotpedia.org/Florida_State_Senate_District_28; https://www.sparkers-soapbox.com/whats-on-the-general-election-ballot-for-collier-county-voters/). Research limitation (Sept 2026): Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, dos.fl.gov, floridaelectionwatch.gov, Florida Politics and all news sites were blocked for fetching in this sandbox and the WebSearch budget was capped, so the roster is built only from search-result snippets; write-in/NPA qualifiers could not be checked. Positions are null because no snippet contained an explicit issue statement.
